name: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk
summary: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk, through its subsidiary, PT Raharja Energi Tanjung Jabung, engages in the mining and excavation of oil and gas business in Indonesia. The company holds a 2.2423% participating interest in the Cepu block; and 8% participating interest in the Jabung block located in the Jambi province. PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk was founded in 2006 and is based in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia. PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Rukun Raharja Tbk.
